pipeline.title: J&J’s Icotyde pill drives biologic-like efficacy in psoriatic arthritis despite high-dose miss
pipeline.summary: Icotyde's strong phase 3 data in biologic-naïve patients with psoriatic arthritis were stained by one disappointment as a high dose missed statistical significance on the primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Zura scraps hidradenitis suppurativa program after phase 2 miss, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: Zura Bio’s tibulizumab has flunked a phase 2 hidradenitis suppurativa trial, prompting the biotech to end development in the indication while continuing studies in other settings.

pipeline.title: J&J-backed Delix drums up $100M series C for non-hallucinatory psychedelic for depression
pipeline.summary: Delix Therapeutics has raised $100 million in a series C round backed by the likes of Johnson & Johnson to advance a phase 2-ready non-hallucinatory psychedelic therapy for depression.

pipeline.title: Kyorin pens $140M deal for Japan rights to Edesa’s phase 3 respiratory drug
pipeline.summary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical is paying $12 million upfront for the Japan rights to Edesa Biotech’s anti-TLR4 antibody to treat acute respiratory distress syndrome.

pipeline.title: Translating Phase II success into Phase III readiness takes more than scale
pipeline.summary: The move from Phase II to Phase III is often treated as a clinical milestone, when it is actually a development-wide transition.

pipeline.title: Vir’s phase 3 hepatitis delta win fuels push to eclipse Gilead
pipeline.summary: Vir Biotechnology’s phase 3 trial in chronic hepatitis delta has hit its primary endpoint, giving the biotech the first piece of the package it needs to file for FDA approval next year.

pipeline.title: Valneva sees LimmaTech vaccine reduce Shigella infections in phase 2 test
pipeline.summary: Valneva’s Shigella vaccine has been shown to reduce cases of intestinal infection, hitting the key endpoint of a phase 2 trial.

pipeline.title: Lilly looks to gird Foundayo label after late-stage win in sleep apnea
pipeline.summary: Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo significantly reduced sleep apnea severity in a phase 3 study presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Monday. Now, the pharma is approaching the FDA in hopes of a label expansion.

pipeline.title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
pipeline.summary: Moderna has scrapped plans to enroll a new cohort in a phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine and instead will meet with regulators to decide on next steps.

pipeline.title: Recent Lisata prize Marea touts ‘exciting’ lipid disorder phase 2 win, mulls obesity potential
pipeline.summary: Fresh from a merger with oncology drugmaker Lisata Therapeutics, cardiometabolic biotech Marea Therapeutics has revealed results from the first part of a phase 2b study showing its drug candidate MAR001 significantly reduced levels of fat in the blood of patients with hypertrigly

pipeline.title: AHA: Boehringer aims for 2027 survodutide submission after obesity drug passes cardio test
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim is gearing up to take survodutide to regulators next year after the obesity drug proved its cardiovascular credentials in its latest phase 3 study.

pipeline.title: Faeth’s phase 2 data power oral combo forward in cancer targeted by ADC heavyweights
pipeline.summary: Faeth Therapeutics’ endometrial cancer prospect has cleared the phase 2 efficacy bar, emboldening the biotech to forge ahead with efforts to establish the oral therapy in a field dominated by injectables.

pipeline.title: ANI makes $560M play for Egetis and its approved orphan drug Emcitate
pipeline.summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals is handing over $560 million to expand its rare disease business with the proposed buyout of Swedish drugmaker Egetis Therapeutics and its lead asset Emcitate, the first and only approved treatment for MCT8 deficiency.

pipeline.title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

pipeline.title: MetaVia sees GLP-1 shed liver fat and body weight in phase 1, takes aim at specific liver disease
pipeline.summary: MetaVia has linked its GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist to reductions in liver fat and body weight in a phase 1 trial. Encouraged by the data, MetaVia plans to start a phase 2 trial in alcohol-associated liver disease next year.

pipeline.title: Use Kidney Genetics to Strengthen Clinical Trial Design
pipeline.summary: Listen to the podcast to learn how genotype-defined kidney disease data can inform trial populations, endpoints and enrollment strategy.

pipeline.title: Vir hepatitis D drug succeeds in first pivotal study
pipeline.summary: A program that’s survived Vir’s pivot away from infectious disease research hit all of its study objectives and appeared more potent than a rival drug also in late-stage development.

pipeline.title: Argenx to buy peptide platform in potentially billion-dollar deal
pipeline.summary: For $550 million up front, Argenx will take control of Unnatural Products’ “macrocyclic peptide” technology and direct it to develop oral, durable medicines for serious immune-mediated diseases.

pipeline.title: FDA opens safety probe into Novartis’ Zolgensma over potential tumor risks
pipeline.summary: In its Nov. 6 communique about its Zolgensma safety probe, the FDA also flagged two recent reports of other gene therapy candidates where AAV vector integration drove tumor formation.

pipeline.title: Ramaswamy’s biotech baggage haunted his political run
